title: The Battle Hymn of the Republic

license.note: Composition: music by William Steffe, words by Julia Ward Howe (1861); both public domain. Recording: Composition: William Steffe; Lyrics: Julia Ward Howe; Arrangement: Floyd Werle; Performance: United States Air Force Band, Singing Sergeants; Recording: United States Air Force, Public domain (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3AThe_Battle_Hymn_of_the_Republic_%281995%29_-_Singing_Sergeants_-_United_States_Air_Force_Band.mp3); backing separated with demucs, lyric timings derived from the recording. Arrangement and performance by the United States Air Force Band (a work of the US Government, public domain).
